About This Product

This modern sofa introduces clean lines and a tailored silhouette that updates your layout. It's crafted with a sturdy solid wood frame to supply a reliable seating foundation across your home. The square armrests give the piece a crisp look, while fabric upholstery wraps the clean-lined frame to deliver a smooth surface. Thick foam-padded seat cushions provide supportive comfort for reading, streaming, or unwinding after a long day. This seating choice fits smoothly into various decor styles. It also seats three people comfortably for gathering with friends or relaxing with family.

Features

  • The medium-firm seat cushions provide a balanced level of everyday support
  • Included fabric throw pillows add a layered look to your seating arrangement
  • A standard sofa design coordinates easily alongside your existing home furniture
  • Removable back cushions make regular upkeep and flipping straightforward
  • Wipe clean with a dry cloth to easily maintain the smooth upholstered exterior
